name: cyber-harness
description: chainreactors Go agent harness (formerly AIScan): a scan agent running the chainreactors scanners, code audit, and a Web Hub that controls nodes
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code and scan data

indicators.context: Exact User-Agent of the cyber-harness scan pipeline's Basic-auth check: a GET with Connection: close to a URL that spray found answering 401, followed by zombie password guessing against it when the answer is Basic. Go net/http client
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the cyber-harness source code

indicators.context: User-Agent of the cyber-harness fetch tool (pseudo-command fetch), with Accept: text/markdown, text/html, text/plain, */*. The model uses it to read advisories, documentation or the target

indicators.context: Exact User-Agent of the same Basic-auth check in AIScan builds (cyber-harness before September 15, 2026, up to v1.0.0-rc3). A bare product word: match the whole header
